landing.chapter01Headline: The city <glow>glows</glow> when you know where to look.
landing.pin1Description: Real venues. Real promoters. Nights worth leaving home for.
landing.pin2Description: Events happening now burn brighter, pulling you closer to the action.
landing.pin3Description: A private collection only you can see.
landing.liveBadge: Tonight in Bucharest · {count, plural, one {# venue glowing} other {# venues glowing}}
landing.heroSub: The city's nightlife, mapped in real time. Every glowing dot is a party waiting to happen.
landing.chapter02Headline: Three steps from <glow>curiosity</glow> to dance floor.
landing.step1Body: Open Firefly and watch the city light up with everywhere worth being.
landing.step2Body: Tap any firefly to peek at the lineup, venue, and the energy you're in for.
landing.step3Body: Heart it, set a reminder, share with the right friends — the night is on your radar.
landing.editorialAlt: Bucharest nightlife through a rain-speckled window
landing.manifestoBody: We don't believe nightlife belongs in a feed of <struck>algorithmic suggestions</struck>. It belongs in <glow>people's hands</glow>, in the city, in the moment a friend says <quote>“wait, where are we going?”</quote>
landing.manifestoFooter: Firefly was built by people who'd rather be at the party than looking for one.

q1.text: It's funny how the nights you never planned become the ones you never forget.
q1.attribution: Maria, catching the first morning tram.

q2.text: Nothing builds character like losing your friends in a club and pretending you're totally fine with it.

q3.text: The afterparty always starts with someone saying 'I know a place.'

q4.text: You know it's a good night when the Uber driver asks if you're sure about the destination.

q5.text: I don't remember the DJ's name, but I'd recognize that set anywhere.
q5.attribution: Răzvan, still thinking about it Monday

q6.text: There's always one friend who knows a place that apparently doesn't exist on Google Maps.

q7.text: The group chat spent 40 minutes choosing a place we stayed at for 23 minutes.

q8.text: Nothing says 'quick drink' like checking the sunrise forecast.

q9.text: We skipped the first party because it looked too quiet. We were wrong.

q10.text: I knew we were in trouble when someone said, 'Let's just check what's nearby.'

q11.text: The best part of the night is finding a place none of you had heard of.

q12.text: There's a very specific moment when 'where are we going?' becomes 'where are we going next?'

q13.text: My screen time is embarrassing. My nightlife knowledge is impressive.

q14.text: The party wasn't even on our list. That's usually how you know.

q15.text: We said rooftop. We did not specify which rooftop.

q16.text: I only knew two people there. By 2 AM, apparently I knew everyone.
